generation.summary: Contextual interpretation and complete-turn contracts, full-text review coverage, transformation constraints, durable regeneration, feedback, legacy composition and fail-closed checks were exercised with explicit fixtures. No live synthesis quality score is claimed.
generation.cost: No live model requests were made by this verification. Incremental model cost: $0. Historical embedding benchmark: 3,435 tokens, estimated $0.0000687 at its September 7 rate; cache order prevents fair cost comparison.

limitations: All cases, identities and integrations are synthetic. No real outreach, payer approval or clinical authority.
Live synthesis and new semantic vectors require explicitly configured server credentials and request budgets. Missing or failed providers pause with no silent fallback.
Model support review is fallible. Exact quote and eligibility checks do not prove every paraphrase is entailed.
TXT, Markdown, PDF and DOCX parsing is bounded: 1 MB, 20 PDF pages, 64,000 extracted characters and 128 passages. No OCR; PDF tables can have uncertain reading order.
Content screening and user attestation do not guarantee patient-data detection. Temporary sandbox data expires with the session; approved published sources and governed evidence remain immutable.
Enterprise identity, real channel integrations, independent healthcare validation, production load, backup restoration and patient outcomes are unverified.

manualSemanticReview.reviewer: Codex manual reading of all ten saved responses and their generated prose/claims/reviews; not independent human assessment
manualSemanticReview.summary: The ten-turn partial run accepted four responses. A reported-interaction schema error stopped the final two prompts; this is not a complete twelve-prompt comparison. The separate Launchpad trace passed 28/28 on this revision.

findings.result: Default next action paused because the model filled requestedAction; schema should require null as runtime already does. One evidence turn timed out during review. Report schema contains a derived text constraint beside a shared reference, rejected by the provider.

Subject is now informative and introduction is a separate neutral acknowledgment. The body still proposed an unsupported document-before-follow-up prerequisite and case-controls wording; deterministic validation correctly paused it. No accepted artifact existed for the next two refinements, which also paused.

Withholding case context produced a valid 62-character generic workspace invitation with channel-policy support. It was generated/not sent and created no effect. This is a newly requested draft after paused predecessors, not a proof of valid conversion lineage.

Rationale explains the current next step with current quoted support. Evidence describes source categories; exact citations remain inspectable, but the direct answer does not quote the requested source passage, so full evidence-answer usefulness is not established.

limitations: Repeated synthetic prompts, no holdout or independent assessment.
Four accepted responses and a successful Launchpad trace do not establish complete conversational acceptance.
Fresh repair qualification and a later complete core remain necessary.
manualSemanticReview.correction: SMS body length measured from the saved response is 62 characters; the earlier review misstated it as 59.

caveats: Exact twelve-prompt core comparison; developer-authored synthetic conversation, not an independent holdout.
Mechanical checks do not prove natural-language entailment or response usefulness; semantic review is separate.
Old bodies include their template subject and internal metadata; each shortening ratio compares that arm’s own body field.
Latency is end-to-end browser submission to saved display, including service/network effects. Cache and free-service cold starts may differ.

Reported generation requests/tokens exclude embedding usage and unreported failed-request tokens. A conservative September 9, 2026 estimate uses $0.40/M input and $1.60/M output, ignoring cache discounts; not a billing record.
The earlier boundary continuation is a reference trace; the new boundary scenario is separately isolated. Only the core is presented as an exact conversational pair.
